subject: Change request: add burst capacity + SOW clarification
messages:
From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie@heliomed.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: add burst capacity + SOW tweak

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was happy with throughput numbers. Our infra lead asked whether we can add a 2x burst pool for unpredictable spikes through Q4 and how that would affect pricing and the SOW (implementation tasks + acceptance criteria).

Can you send a change order + redline notes we can share with procurement/legal? We have a draft PO ready but want to align the scope first.

Key asks from our side:
- 2x burst capacity available up to 200 vGPU-hours/day for the next 3 months
- Clear billing proration if we scale mid-month
- One-week extension to the acceptance test window to account for regulatory checks

Cc'ing Procurement (procurement@heliomed.com).

Thanks,
Natalie Ruiz
Head of Platform
HelioMed

[Attachment: none in this message]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Ruiz <natalie@heliomed.com>
Cc: HelioMed Procurement <procurement@heliomed.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add burst capacity + SOW tweak

Hi Natalie — great to hear. Attached is a first-pass change order that adds a burst pool and proposes a prorated billing approach. High level:

- Burst pool: 200 vGPU-hr/day cap, billed at a 1.6x premium to base capacity.
- Proration: daily granularity for billing; month-of-change prorated based on peak hours used.
- SOW: proposed 1-week acceptance extension (we flagged the regulatory test activities).

Next steps I suggest: 1) internal legal review on the SOW wording and price floor, 2) you confirm PO timing, 3) we'll send a DocuSign when the redlines are resolved.

I've attached CI-ChangeOrder-draft-v1.pdf — it's a clean draft with the proposed clauses called out (Implementation schedule, Pricing table, Acceptance test).

Thanks — I'll loop in Karthik and Laura from legal to do the redline.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0113

[Attachment: CI-ChangeOrder-draft-v1.pdf (Change order draft, 6 pages)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Request: add burst capacity + SOW tweak — legal review requested

Team — forwarding HelioMed's request and the draft change order. High priority: procurement is ready to issue a PO if we can confirm SOW acceptance language and the billing proration. Short bullets for review:
1) Pricing: is 1.6x on burst reasonable vs. base? HelioMed may ask for volume credit if they commit to additional reserved capacity later.
2) Proration mechanics: we suggested daily granularity. Legal to confirm whether we should tie to token or hour metrics.
3) Acceptance testing: customer asked for +1 week for regulatory checks — propose to permit a one-week extension for documented regulatory gating items only.

Please redline directly and return by EOD Friday so I can send v2 to Natalie and procurement. Deal/HubSpot ID: HS-4821.

Thanks,
Monica

[Internal note: attach the draft to legal review]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 14:56:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Request: add burst capacity + SOW tweak — legal review requested

Monica / team — reviewed and attached suggested redlines (redlines_karthik_20260904.docx). Summary of material edits:
- Pricing table: keep burst premium but add conditional volume credit: if HelioMed converts at least 60% of average monthly burst usage into reserved capacity within 90 days, apply a retroactive credit to the burst charges capped at 25% of the month’s burst spend.
- Proration: clarify billing metric as vGPU-hour to avoid ambiguity (token vs hour confusion). Use daily vGPU-hour buckets; prorate the day when the switch occurs based on recorded vGPU-hours consumed.
- Acceptance: allow one-week extension for regulatory gating but require HelioMed to provide a one-line description of the gating activity and an approver signature on completion. Adds a small acceptance holdback (5% of implementation fee) released upon successful regulatory sign-off.
- Misc: modest tightened language on termination for overuse and liability carveouts around experimental workloads.

If we agree, patch these back into the PDF and send to Natalie with a DocuSign link. I also flagged the need for procurement to confirm billing contact and PO cadence (monthly vs net-30).

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlines_karthik_20260904.docx]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Ruiz <natalie@heliomed.com>, HelioMed Procurement <procurement@heliomed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 10:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated change order + request for signature (DocuSign)

Hi Natalie — thanks for the quick sync last week. Per Karthik's redlines I've attached CI-ChangeOrder-v2.pdf and summarized the key updates below so procurement/legal can review quickly:

- Burst pricing: 1.6x premium retained; conditional retro credit if burst converts to reserved capacity (see clause 3.2).
- Billing/proration: vGPU-hour based, daily buckets; month-of-change prorated per vGPU-hour usage on the day of change.
- Acceptance: one-week extension for documented regulatory gating items; 5% implementation holdback until sign-off (clause 5.1).
- Implementation timeline: added explicit handoff steps and a single point of contact for coordination (Jonas Weber).

Attachments: CI-ChangeOrder-v2.pdf (attached with tracked changes). DocuSign link to sign: https://www.docusign.com/embedded?envelopeId=abc123-changeorder. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4821.

Please confirm: 1) procurement cadence (monthly vs net-30) and 2) whether HelioMed Legal wants us to loop Edison Suzuki directly on the DocuSign package or route via Natalie. If procurement confirms a PO timeline we can hold the effective date to the start of next billing period.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: CI-ChangeOrder-v2.pdf (Change order with legal redlines)]

From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie@heliomed.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, HelioMed Procurement <procurement@heliomed.com>
Cc: Edison Suzuki <edsuzuki@lawfirm.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated change order + request for signature (DocuSign)

Monica — appreciate the rapid turnaround. Procurement confirms they will issue a PO by Friday, target effective date 2026-10-01 provided DocuSign is complete by 2026-09-14. Two small asks from legal/ops:

1) We accept the vGPU-hour billing metric but request the acceptance window tweak: extend the overall acceptance test window to 3 weeks (was 2) to account for vendor scheduling for regulatory checks. We still agree to the one-week documented gating extension you propose; this would be an additional buffer.

2) Route final DocuSign packet to Edison Suzuki (edsuzuki@lawfirm.com) and cc Natalie + procurement. Edison will perform a quick counsel review and sign.

If you can update CI-ChangeOrder-v2 to explicitly call out the 3-week base acceptance window (with the one-week gating extension clause preserved), we can sign off next week.

Best,
Natalie Ruiz
Head of Platform | HelioMed
